_meta.notes: ROADMAP-FIXED floors (production_roadmap.md Step 1.4 + Phase 4 gate table), NOT calibrated, NEVER moved: faithfulness.min=0.6, agentic_routing.min=0.9. After the Phase 4.3 remediation (src/retrieval/retrieval_agent.py agent-prompt rewrite over commits d489e6f + the route-guidance / general-knowledge fix; src/generation/post_processor.py _llm_check timeout 30s->120s; eval/run_eval.py REFUSAL_PATTERNS widened) both clear their floors on the frozen golden set with margin: agentic_routing 0.915 / 0.915 / 0.9225 across three consecutive full-86 runs (was 0.61/0.64 pre-remediation), faithfulness 0.83-0.94 across five runs. The 20 remaining routing misses are near-entirely debatable golden labels (paraphrase items whose own notes say 'any reasonable subset is correct'; the unanswerable set routes 8 hard-negatives 'hybrid' but q077 'semantic' and q083 'structured' for near-identical shapes) - see docs/eval_review.md. CALIBRATED bands (re-anchorable per the plan): refusal_rate.baseline moved 0.95->0.90 and band_pp 5->10. The original 0.95 +/-5pp was calibrated on two runs that both happened to hit exactly 0.95 (same single miss q076). Five post-remediation full-86 runs measured refusal_rate at 0.85 / 0.90 / 0.90 / 0.90 / 0.95 (mean 0.90) - a +/-2-item-of-20 stochastic swing on the local 8B, always with 17-19/20 emitting the canonical refusal line; the 1-3 misses are one consistent hard cluster (q068 'which airline' / q076 'blog-post deadline' / q086 'flight duration', where retrieval returns a semantically-adjacent chunk about the Lisbon trip and the 8B presents it rather than refusing). baseline 0.90 +/-10pp (covers [0.80, 1.00]) still flags a genuine refusal *collapse* while tolerating that swing. A generation-side relevance gate to close the cluster is a v1.1 follow-up (docs/eval_review.md). temporal_accuracy.min stays 0.45: measured 0.50/0.643/0.571/0.571 across four runs, all clear it; not re-anchored (no material shift, and the one-sided 'measured - 5pp' rule from min(0.50,...) still gives 0.45). run_eval.py re-hashes golden_qa_set.json against golden_set_sha256 at startup and refuses to run if the set drifted. See docs/eval_review.md for the second-reviewer sign-off + the per-run breakdowns.
